subject.title: La Cañada Unified School District Board

text: Occupation: Incumbent

Four years ago, I ran for LCUSD's Governing Board to ensure representation for all students. I am proud of the work I have done, the voices I have amplified, and I am eager to continue serving as a member of the LCUSD Governing Board.

During my tenure on the board, LCUSD has continued to position itself as a top-performing district, as seen in its CAASPP test results, received top ratings on Niche and US News and World Report, and an extraordinary percentage of our graduates pursue postsecondary studies and vocations. LCUSD maintains strong enrollment and an uncommon fiscal stability, which made the board's approval of going out for another bond measure that much more meaningful of an investment.

We have approved policies, new courses, new curriculum, and budgets that reflect our collective goals and support an exceptional educational experience. In addition, I look forward to a seamless transition of our new Superintendent. Lastly, I remain laser-focused on policy, procedures, and practices which ensure the safety of our students.
I look forward to continuing the work of the board as we seek the best solutions to changing needs while maintaining what works well for all LCUSD students.

text: Shilpa Shinde-Garg, MD, is a longtime La Cañada Flintridge resident, physician, and dedicated community volunteer committed to education and public service. She and her husband, orthopedic surgeon Dr. Rishi Garg, have raised their two children in the La Cañada Unified School District, where both have thrived.

Dr. Shinde-Garg's passion for education began at UC Berkeley, where she tutored underserved students through Break the Cycle. She later taught science in South Central Los Angeles before earning her medical degree from the USC Keck School of Medicine in 2005. She has practiced Internal Medicine ever since.

Her community leadership includes helping lead the successful Measure LCF campaign to secure long-term funding for local schools. She currently serves as President of the LCHS Flag Football Foundation and previously served as President of the LCHS Spartan Football Foundation, a director on the LCHS Boosters, and a stadium turf advisor for LCUSD.

As a physician, parent, and community leader, Dr. Shinde-Garg believes strong public schools are the foundation of a thriving community. She is committed to academic excellence, fiscal responsibility, student well-being, and strong partnerships with teachers, families, and the community to ensure every student has the opportunity to succeed.

text: As an educator, parent, and La Cañada community member, I am running for the LCUSD School board to bring an authentic classroom perspective, deep institutional understanding, and a parent's heart to our district. Over my 18 year career as a LCHS English teacher, I have dedicated my career to empowering students to succeed inside and outside the classroom. I have served the district as English department chair, WASC coordinator, Leadership and School site council representative, negotiation team member, and advisor to numerous clubs on campus including Speech and Debate and ASB. As a parent and grandparent, my children graduated from La Cañada High School and my grandson will begin his elementary education in the next few years. Contributing to the education of children has given me the chance to understand the unique needs of our community and gain an understanding of all of its members from teachers, administrators, families, and most importantly students whose educational experience depends on the shared values of all of us. I am committed to support every student through compassionate governance ensuring the continued excellence of our schools.

text: Occupation: Attorney
It has been my honor to serve on the La Cañada Unified School District Governing Board for the past 13 years, including two terms as Board President.
Throughout my service, I have listened to students, parents, teachers, and staff while making thoughtful, transparent decisions that put students first.

Together, our district has achieved remarkable success LCUSD has been recognized as California's top-ranked school district and among the best in the nation. Our elementary schools earned National Blue Ribbon recognition, and our students rank first among California unified school districts in English language arts and second in mathematics on statewide assessments.
We have maintained stable enrollment, preserved a balanced budget, passed bond measures to modernize our schools and technology, and successfully welcomed the Sagebrush area into our district.

While I am proud of these accomplishments, important work remains. I remain committed to academic excellence, strong student support services, outstanding educators, modern facilities, fiscal responsibility, and transparent governance.
I care deeply about our schools and remain dedicated to ensuring every student receives a world-class education in a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment.
It would be an honor to continue serving the families of the La Cañada Unified School District.

text: Age: 47
Occupation: Attorney

I am running for the LCUSD School Board because I believe education is the bedrock of thriving communities and I am dedicated to ensuring that our schools provide an excellent environment for learning and belonging for all students.

I attended LCUSD from elementary through high school, and when my wife and I started our family, we chose La Canada so our four children could benefit from the same exceptional schools and close-knit community that shaped me.
As an attorney and entrepreneur, I have the legal, financial, and governance experience to help ensure taxpayer dollars are managed transparently and responsibly.

I have dedicated myself to serving our community through coaching youth softball and basketball, volunteering with the PTA, supporting scouting, and serving on the District's Citizens Oversight and Parcel Tax Committees to help ensure voter-approved funds were spent as promised.

As a Trustee, I will continue to support our community by maintaining a focus on student learning and well-being, transparent and responsible governance, and supporting our new Superintendent's leadership. I believe every student deserves to feel a true sense of belonging in our schools. I know firsthand the power of an LCUSD education, and I am committed to preserving that promise.
